idea-plugin.name: MBTraining Karate Pack
idea-plugin.description:
MBTraining Karate Pack is a proof of concept (POC) training content pack for MBTraining Engine Framework.

Important: all exercise content in this pack is AI-generated. Some exercises may be counter-intuitive, incomplete, or not runnable in your environment.

This plugin is intended to demonstrate the pack architecture and learning flow, not to provide production-ready or fully validated training content.

What it includes:

  • A staged roadmap from basic scripting to end-to-end API flow exercises
  • Pack-defined onboarding content and learner guidance
  • Exercise metadata consumed by the engine for progress tracking and validation

If you want the framework to create your own exercise packs and publish your own content set, email: duy5a247@gmail.com. The framework can be open sourced on request.
